# StochasticSpikeEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST

## Definition
A method of encoding information into the stochastic timing or probability of spike generation, influenced by quantum noise or measurement outcomes. Leverages inherent randomness for robust, energy-efficient computation and probabilistic inference in neuromorphic hardware.
